sloka: यक्षत्वम् अमरत्वम् च राज्यानि विविधानि च ।अत्र देवाः प्रयच्छन्ति भूतैः आराधिताः शुभैः ॥३-११-९३॥
transliteration: yakṣatvam amaratvam ca rājyāni vividhāni ca ।atra devāḥ prayacchanti bhūtaiḥ ārādhitāḥ śubhaiḥ ॥3-11-93॥

translations.english: Worshipped by benevolent beings, the gods here bestow on them the status of demigods or of the immortals or several kinds of kingdoms.
